content: Keep your critic near you, build him a hut in your courtyard; for without soap and water, he cleanses your character.
author: Kabir
explanation: While flatterers reinforce your blind spots and inflate your ego, an honest critic unsparingly illuminates your shortcomings, providing free purification for your character.
practicalInsight: Listen to critical feedback today without getting defensive. Extract the grain of truth that can elevate your mastery.
reflectionPrompt: How can I turn my critics into unconscious coaches for my self-refinement?
